name: Magnet Cursor Grid
description: Custom dot-and-ring cursor that snaps and morphs onto the icon button under the pointer in a centered grid, while sibling buttons dim to spotlight the hovered one.
contents: Grid of square icon buttons with an svg icon each
Custom cursor made of a small dot and an outer ring
behavior: Native cursor is hidden over the component
Inner dot follows the pointer, outer ring trails it with a short tween
Ring morphs into the hovered button's rectangle and tints with a hover color
Dot scales up while the pointer is pressed
Other buttons dim while the grid is hovered
editableByProps: Number of buttons, their svg icon paths and labels

needsCodeEdit.change: Make buttons links or add click handlers

needsCodeEdit.where: magnet-target class string on the button

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Hides the native cursor inside the component and relies on mouse pointer, so it is not useful on touch devices
Listens for pointer events on document.body and scroll on window, removed on unmount
